scenario.summary: SafePay ransomware actors gain initial access through credential harvesting, brute-force attacks, and exploitation of vulnerabilities in VPN and edge devices like Cisco and Veeam. Once inside, they escalate privileges via UAC bypass, move laterally using RDP and PsExec, and utilize RMM tools for persistence before exfiltrating data and deploying encryption.

meta.rationale: Focus on internet-facing assets including VPN gateways, backup servers (Veeam), and firewalls. Expand to administrative workstations if account manipulation is detected.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary has exploited a known edge vulnerability to gain a foothold and is consolidating control by creating administrative accounts and escalating local privileges via UAC bypass.

hunt.name: SafePay: External Access and Identity Consolidation
hunt.description: SafePay actors use vulnerabilities in Cisco VPNs, Veeam backups, and SonicWall firewalls to enter the network. The hunt identifies exposed assets and monitors for brute-force attacks against the beachhead. The gated structure ensures the analyst only performs expensive behavioral analysis on hosts that show a real exposure. The hunt then checks for new account creations and privilege escalation attempts before an agent weighs the combined evidence and an analyst confirms the threat.

config.scoping_notes: Focus on internet-facing assets including VPN gateways, backup servers (Veeam), and firewalls. Expand to administrative workstations if account manipulation is detected.
config.beyond_detection: A simple rule for UAC bypass or account creation often triggers false positives for legitimate administrative tasks. This hunt uses a gated vulnerability check and an agent-led triage to correlate vulnerable state with suspicious behavior, providing higher confidence before containment.

config.content: SELECT device_uid, cve_uid, severity, resource_uid, status FROM hb_vulnerability_finding WHERE (instr(',' || '{{safepay_cves}}' || ',', ',' || cve_uid || ',') > 0) AND status != 'suppressed'
config.description: Find devices currently reporting vulnerabilities used by SafePay for initial access.
config.expected_signal: A list of device UIDs and resource paths vulnerable to the specified CVEs. Silence means no known-vulnerable assets are reporting.

primitive_config.label: Identify vulnerable edge infrastructure
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_uid, cve_uid, severity, resource_uid, status FROM hb_vulnerability_finding WHERE (instr(',' || '{{safepay_cves}}' || ',', ',' || cve_uid || ',') > 0) AND status != 'suppressed'
primitive_config.expected: A list of device UIDs and resource paths vulnerable to the specified CVEs. Silence means no known-vulnerable assets are reporting.

config.objective: Summarize the exposure: how many hosts are vulnerable to SafePay-linked CVEs and which CVEs are most prevalent.
config.description: Read the scoping results to determine if follow-on behavioral queries are justified.

config.question: vulnerable-gate finds at least one host or resource with a critical or high severity vulnerability
config.condition: vulnerable-gate finds at least one host or resource with a critical or high severity vulnerability
config.description: Stop the hunt if no vulnerable assets are found, or fan out to behavioral queries.

config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, actor_user_name, device_hostname, COUNT(*) as attempts, MIN(time) as first_seen, MAX(time) as last_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE status_id = 2 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip, actor_user_name, device_hostname HAVING attempts > 20 ORDER BY attempts DESC
config.description: Identify external brute-force attempts targeting administrative or phished accounts.
config.expected_signal: A high volume of failed sign-ins from a single source IP, potentially targeting multiple accounts.

primitive_config.label: Brute-force and logon anomalies
primitive_config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, actor_user_name, device_hostname, COUNT(*) as attempts, MIN(time) as first_seen, MAX(time) as last_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE status_id = 2 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip, actor_user_name, device_hostname HAVING attempts > 20 ORDER BY attempts DESC
primitive_config.expected: A high volume of failed sign-ins from a single source IP, potentially targeting multiple accounts.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, user_name, actor_user_name, activity_name, time FROM hb_account_change WHERE activity_id IN (1, 3, 4) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Detect the creation of new accounts or unauthorized password resets used for persistence.
config.expected_signal: Account creation (activity_id 1) or password changes/resets (3, 4) on critical servers, especially by unexpected actors.

primitive_config.label: Suspicious account manipulation
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, user_name, actor_user_name, activity_name, time FROM hb_account_change WHERE activity_id IN (1, 3, 4) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Account creation (activity_id 1) or password changes/resets (3, 4) on critical servers, especially by unexpected actors.

nodes.label: Local privilege escalation via UAC bypass

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, integrity_level, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE integrity_level = 'High' AND (LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%\\powershell.exe') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find high-integrity processes spawned from interactive or shell-based parents, indicating UAC bypass.
config.expected_signal: High integrity processes with command-line arguments that imply interactive shell execution. Silence proves the absence of this specific behavior on the monitored hosts.

primitive_config.label: Local privilege escalation via UAC bypass

primitive_config.expected: High integrity processes with command-line arguments that imply interactive shell execution. Silence proves the absence of this specific behavior on the monitored hosts.

config.objective: Determine if any host showing initial access indicators (vuln + brute force) has also progressed to persistence or privilege escalation.
config.description: Synthesize vulnerability state with behavioral evidence to determine if a host is compromised.
config.success_criteria: A verdict of malicious, suspicious, or benign per host, citing specific rows for each stage of the attack chain.

config.question: The triage verdict is malicious for at least one host showing both account manipulation and privilege escalation.
config.condition: The triage verdict is malicious for at least one host showing both account manipulation and privilege escalation.
config.description: Trigger host isolation for confirmed intrusions or manual review for ambiguous signals.
Contain the threat before it moves to share enumeration or exfiltration.
config.instructions: Isolate the host immediately. Lock the actor's session and revoke the credentials used for the suspicious account activity.

config.description: Investigate suspicious findings that did not meet the immediate isolation threshold.
config.instructions: Review the triage verdicts. For suspicious hosts, verify the source IPs of the auth failures and the process tree of the UAC bypass. Confirm if the account changes were authorized.

config.description: Document findings and update vulnerability posture.
config.instructions: Record the vulnerable hosts identified. If the behavioral queries were empty, document the negative result as evidence of absence of post-exploitation activity on the exposed surface.
